name: Default
shortDescription: Open-source conversational form builder for surveys, quizzes and polls, backed by MongoDB and Redis with persistent uploads.

alerts.message: Sign-up is open to anyone who can reach the URL. Create your account, then set APP_DISABLE_REGISTRATION to true and redeploy; invited collaborators can still join. Email is not sent until you fill in the SMTP_* variables.
HTTPS is required: session cookies are marked secure, so logging in over plain HTTP does not work.
